## Summary
- refresh the Phase 0 stable-release aggregate audit to current main after PR #666
- add the after-666 blocked evidence bundle with PR snapshots, workflow snapshots, gate summaries, release-claim fail-closed exit captures, and checksums
- keep Phase 0 explicitly blocked while recording PR #665 as evidence-tool hardening and PR #666 as no-Host dialog evidence only

## Verification
- Remote Phase 0 checks run `34120456261` completed successfully for commit `3c1ad98748cb6e6834dc9a89c7b8e1de82d59e3f`, including phase3, macos, protocol, android, and evidence-tools jobs.
- Remote iOS engineering run `34120456414` and HarmonyOS portable run `34120456371` completed successfully for the same commit.
- `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_phase0_stable_release tools.tests.test_phase0_module_ownership -v` -> 83 tests OK.
- `make phase0-module-ownership-gate PHASE0_MODULE_OWNERSHIP_SUMMARY=docs/changes/2026-08-22-phase0-stable-release-aggregate/evidence/2026-09-07-after-666-current-main-gate-blocked/phase0-module-ownership-summary.json` -> pass summary written.
- `make phase0-stable-release-gate PHASE0_STABLE_RELEASE_EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT=3c1ad98748cb6e6834dc9a89c7b8e1de82d59e3f PHASE0_STABLE_RELEASE_SUMMARY=docs/changes/2026-08-22-phase0-stable-release-aggregate/evidence/2026-09-07-after-666-current-main-gate-blocked/phase0-stable-release-summary.json` -> guard passes, aggregate remains blocked.
- `PHASE0_STABLE_RELEASE_REQUIRE_PASS=1 make phase0-stable-release-gate` -> captured exit 2, fail-closed because release-claim mode requires expected source commit.
- `PHASE0_STABLE_RELEASE_REQUIRE_PASS=1 PHASE0_STABLE_RELEASE_EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT=3c1ad98748cb6e6834dc9a89c7b8e1de82d59e3f PHASE0_STABLE_RELEASE_SUMMARY=docs/changes/2026-08-22-phase0-stable-release-aggregate/evidence/2026-09-07-after-666-current-main-gate-blocked/phase0-stable-release-summary.json make phase0-stable-release-gate` -> captured exit 2, fail-closed because aggregate remains blocked.
- `make evidence-tools-test` -> passed.
- `shasum -a 256 -c docs/changes/2026-08-22-phase0-stable-release-aggregate/evidence/2026-09-07-after-666-current-main-gate-blocked/SHA256SUMS` -> all OK.
- `git diff --check` -> OK.
